base_member_text: [L52] (LOW/quoting/path) The test executable path is unquoted, so a solution directory containing whitespace cannot be executed reliably.
audit_member_text: [L52] (MED/path-quoting) The test executable path is unquoted, so a solution directory containing spaces prevents correct execution.

base_member_text: [L38-L43] (MED/error-handling) The test-project build and xbeach build are issued back-to-back and only the final command’s status is checked, so failure of the first build can be masked before tests run.
audit_member_text: [L26-L30,L38-L43] (HIGH/exit-status) ERRORLEVEL is checked only after log-display commands and a second build, so the cleanup and individual build failures are not reliably preserved before tests run.

base_member_text: [L10-L18] (MED/version/dispatch) Only VS2010 is explicitly recognized; VS2012 and later inputs fall through to the VS2008 path despite the repository containing newer solution files.
audit_member_text: [L10-L18] (MED/toolchain-selection) Every version other than VS2010 silently selects Visual Studio 2008, including newer solution versions.

base_member_text: [L26,L38-L39] (MED/command/path) The command uses `%devenv_path%\devenv.exe` even though devenv_path itself contains surrounding quotes, producing a questionable quoted executable path and leaving the intended invocation unclear.
